prompt: Can you review this branch before I merge it? And once that's done I want the messy bits cleaned up.
expectations: Names both the local code-review and the plugin code-review:code-review, distinguishing which is which, and picks one rather than handing the choice back to the user
Every discriminator the pick or the rejection rests on holds against what those skills actually declare
The stated reason for the pick is not contradicted elsewhere in the same outputs
Holds the cleanup conditional on what the review returns, because the simplifier declares it must not run on broken code - and says so in response.md
